general.title: Emporiqa
general.description: Sync products and pages, test your connection, and manage integration settings.

infoBanner.quickSetup: Quick Setup: 1. Click Connect to Emporiqa below to link your store in one click, or enter your Store ID and Webhook Secret manually and save. 2. Run your first sync from the Sync tab.

connect.connectHelp: One click connects this shop to your Emporiqa account and fills in the credentials automatically.
connect.initiateError: Could not start the connection to Emporiqa. Please try again.

callback.title: Connect to Emporiqa
callback.successMessage: Your shop is now connected. The credentials have been saved automatically.
callback.errorGeneric: The connection could not be completed. Please try again.
callback.missingParams: The callback is missing required parameters. Please start the connection again from the settings page.

settings.saveError: Failed to save settings. Please try again.
settings.loadError: Failed to load settings. Showing defaults, please check your connection and reload.

connection.title: Connection
connection.storeIdHelp: Find it in your Emporiqa dashboard at Settings → Integration → Integration overview.
connection.webhookSecretHelp: Find it in your Emporiqa dashboard at Settings → Integration → Integration overview.
connection.errorGeneric: Connection test failed. Check your Store ID and Webhook Secret.
connection.saveFirst: Save your settings before testing the connection.
connection.noProductFound: No active products found to test with. Using test payload.
connection.orderTrackingUrlHelp: Copy this URL into your Emporiqa dashboard under Settings, Integration, Order tracking.

syncSettings.brandSourceHelp: Select which property group to use as the brand source, or keep the default to use the product manufacturer.

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.webhookUrlHelp: Only change this if you run a custom Emporiqa instance.

welcome.title: Connected to Emporiqa. One more step.
welcome.body: Send your products and pages to Emporiqa so the chat has something to recommend. Everything is sent in batches in the background, so you can close this tab once it starts.

sync.title: Sync Dashboard
sync.syncProductsDescription: Send the full product catalog to Emporiqa.
sync.syncPagesDescription: Send all CMS landing pages to Emporiqa.
sync.syncAllDescription: Send both products and pages in one operation.

driver.nothingToSync: Nothing to sync, no active products or pages found.
driver.skippedIncomplete: Skipped completing the {entity} session: one or more batches failed. No items were deleted on Emporiqa.
driver.finishedWithErrors: Sync finished with errors. Check the log for details.

cli.title: CLI Commands
cli.description: These commands are available in the Shopware CLI. Each sync command also supports a --dry-run flag.
